item.text: The audit found `findUser` and `UserRepository.findById` can return a deleted user. Payment reads also need to respect their order’s visibility. I’ll treat a deleted user’s orders and payments as hidden across reads and reports, then cover those cases in tests.

The filters and endpoint are in place. I added fixtures for a payment on a deleted user’s order and a deleted payment, so the tests can verify those payments stay out of reads and totals. I’ll run the suite and route check now.
